title: Check and change audit scan a legacy module.req.md for duplicate requirement IDs
description: check and change audit scan a legacy module.req.md for duplicate requirement IDs
no_spec_change_rationale: Makes check and change audit match REQ-validator-045 and REQ-change-125, which refuse a requirements file that repeats a requirement ID: a legacy {module}.req.md companion is a requirements file, as the hash cache and the merge driver already read it, but neither scan opened it.
acceptance_criteria: check and change audit refuse a requirement ID repeated in a legacy <module>.req.md, naming the ID and the file, as they do in requirements.md (red then green)
